title: The pricing table I was looking for
description: A side-by-side look at the Starter, Pro, and Enterprise plans. All the details, in one place.
text:
Acme pricing overview
Starter: $19/month. 3 projects, basic analytics, community support.
Pro: $49/month. Unlimited projects, advanced analytics, priority support.
Enterprise: Custom pricing. SSO, dedicated support, custom integrations.
Reviewed during Tuesday’s product meeting.

title: Good ideas from the team sync
description: The moment we talked about making capture feel effortless. Worth coming back to.
text:
[02:14] Maya: What if saving context was as simple as taking a screenshot?
[02:31] Alex: The key is preserving where you were, not just what you saw.
[03:06] Maya: Let’s prioritize on-demand capture, then make every snapshot searchable.
[04:10] Alex: Agreed. We should keep everything local, with no cloud dependency.

title: Notes for a more focused day
description: A few thoughts on deep work, attention, and making space for what matters.
text:
Make space for what matters
1. Start the day with one clear intention.
2. Give your attention to one thing at a time.
3. Capture the thought, then come back to the task.
4. Leave a little room to think.
Attention is a finite resource. Spend it on purpose.
